parts.html: The K-04 standard model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in gray with a natural quartzite countertop. Solid-color painted fronts and the strict geometry of the cabinets create an understated, elegant interior.
Gray is versatile: it pairs well with wood, stone, light walls, and dark decor.
Without an island, the L-shaped layout fits the work surface and cabinets along two walls and leaves a clear walkway — a good choice when every square meter counts.
Storage is provided by a cargo pull-out and AvanTech YOU Hettich drawers, while the doors close smoothly on Hettich soft-close hinges.
We will tailor the K-04 to your kitchen’s dimensions, utility connections, and appliance placement, and the storage system to your needs.
